MemoryPhoto.title: MemoryPhoto
MemoryPhoto.description: A family memory photograph record stored permanently in the Chinthala family archive.

id.description: Unique identifier for the memory photo.

title.description: Title or headline of the memory photograph.

album.description: The album or chapter name the photo belongs to.

imageUrl.description: URL or high-resolution data URI of the photo.

location.description: Location where the photograph was captured.

familyMembers.description: List of family members featured in the photograph.

/memories/{memoryId}.description: Worldwide permanent storage of Chinthala family memories.
